items.title: Recent UnrealIRCd Vulnerability Exploited in Attacks
items.summary: Tracked as CVE-2026-114713, the high-severity flaw allows attackers to execute commands with server/IRCOp privileges. The post Recent UnrealIRCd Vulnerability Exploited in Attacks appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: Google Project Zero Sets Course for 30-Day Disclosure Deadline
items.summary: It will move to a 60-day vulnerability disclosure window in February 2027 and to a 30-day window in January 2028. The post Google Project Zero Sets Course for 30-Day Disclosure Deadline appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: Optimizely hack infected CNN, Fox News, BBC, Salesforce sites with malware
items.summary: A suspected supply chain attack targeting Optimizely has led to malicious JavaScript being loaded on numerous popular websites, including Zoom, CNN, Fox News, BBC, Salesforce, and GitLab, exposing visitors to scripts designed to steal cryptocurrency and payment information and exploit vulnerabilities in iOS devices. [...]

items.title: Cursor Supply Chain Attack Started at Fireworks AI
items.summary: The attacker stole an access key from Fireworks and used it to exfiltrate credentials that enabled them to push malicious Claude Code extension copies. The post Cursor Supply Chain Attack Started at Fireworks AI appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: Uber notifies drivers of data breach affecting nearly 150,000 people
items.summary: Ride-hailing company Uber is notifying nearly 150,000 drivers that attackers stole their data after breaching AI infrastructure provider Fireworks in early October. [...]

items.title: Barracuda links cloud breach to ARTEX AI-powered cyberattack
items.summary: Hackers who breached the cloud environment of network and email security company Barracuda earlier this month used a stolen cloud access key and the ARTEX AI penetration testing framework. [...]

items.title: Fandango says hackers stole payment card details from checkout pages
items.summary: Ticket seller Fandango Media is notifying customers about a data breach that exposed payment card details entered on its checkout pages. [...]

items.title: Uber Data Breach Impacts 150,000 People
items.summary: Hackers compromised a third-party services provider and stole names, addresses, and driver’s license numbers. The post Uber Data Breach Impacts 150,000 People appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: New NoisyTCP vulnerability lets attackers crash Linux servers
items.summary: An 11-year-old Linux kernel vulnerability, dubbed NoisyTCP, affects almost all Linux distributions and lets attackers crash systems running Nginx, Apache, and SSH servers with default configurations. [...]

items.title: Barracuda Hacked Amid Surge in Artex-Powered Cyberattacks
items.summary: Chinese threat actors are broadly adopting the agentic AI penetration testing framework to accelerate their attacks. The post Barracuda Hacked Amid Surge in Artex-Powered Cyberattacks appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: Google warns that fully-automated AI attacks are coming soon
items.summary: Threat actors are now relying on agentic workflows powered by AI-based offensive frameworks to automate vulnerability discovery and exploitation, accelerating attacks to machine speed. [...]

items.title: Telegram Widgets Hit by RCE Demos, Malware Warning Days After Launch
